Returned IFC mesh triangles against source axis-aligned opening volumes, with 5 mm tolerance at jamb/sill/head. All door/window fixtures in this sweep have axis-aligned hosts or are axis-aligned freestanding reservations.

Explicit plate/gusset thickness or cylindrical shaft diameter versus solid dimensions; tolerance max(0.005 in, 2%). Resolve against actual completed design records, not by relabelling an arbitrary solid.

Actual physical catalogue section label versus every linked member record with an explicit inputs.section. Custom profile aliases and built-up constituent calculations are outside this exact-label screen.
Deep gravity-framing profiles: detect depth axis nearly perpendicular to projected gravity; inspect intentional weak-axis designs separately.
Separate built-up constituents must not substantially occupy the same section area; threshold >0.005 in2 and >5% of a constituent, allowing preview fillet simplifications.

Explicit hardware notes and column bases lacking any connection-part bounds within six feet; continuous-subdivision claims must have opposing collinear member ends. Checks returned solid and reference-part bounds. Nearness alone is not connection completeness, fit or capacity certification.
